message.name: About me
description: A flexible, proactive and positive Full Stack Engineer with success in managing development projects. Successfully managed development projects and created new websites with mathematical and logical solutions. An expert at multitasking and can handle multiple projects at once, while still meeting all deadlines.

I studied Computer Science at Moscow State Industrial University from 2012 to 2014. Started my career journey from Junior Frontend Developer to Team Leader & Full Stack Engineer, working across different countries including Russia, Ukraine, Israel, and Poland. My experience spans from startups to large enterprises like EPAM Systems.

My philosophy is to create things that could really help people. I try to create intuitive, accessible, beautiful, and fun digital products. Also great at explaining technical information in a clear and understandable way to audiences.

message.name: Omnito (2023-now)
description: Team Leader & Full Stack Engineer leading a cross-functional team of 8 (4 in-house engineers and 4 contractors) delivering an enterprise multi-tenant SaaS scheduling platform. Own architecture, code review, mentoring, and delivery across frontend, backend, and infra.

Designed 40+ serverless microservices on AWS Lambda (Node.js, Java 21, Python) with DynamoDB, AppSync GraphQL, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS/SQS, Step Functions, and S3 — unified by an OpenAPI-driven codegen pipeline shared across frontend and backend. Built the web client in React 18, TypeScript, Redux/Saga, and PrimeReact, and extended it onto Outlook add-ins, Chrome/Edge extensions, and Gmail/Outlook Web embeds.

Shipped production AI features: an LLM Notetaker auto-summarizing meeting transcripts — 2,000+ summaries per quarter, around 340 engineering hours saved per quarter — plus conversational AI agents built on Flowise and Chatwoot, with reliability tracked via PostHog telemetry. Drove team-wide adoption of AI-assisted development and established Agile/Scrum workflows from scratch.

message.name: EPAM Systems (2021-2023)
description: Lead Engineer managing a team of three developers, working on multiple high-performance React websites with Redux and TypeScript. Responsible for EPIC planning and implementation for the next quarter.

Successfully managed development projects with a branched network of internal service modules. Collaborated with backend teams using Java/Python (FastAPI) and Ruby (Rails) to design and integrate scalable APIs.

Previously worked as Senior Frontend Developer (2020-2021) developing projects from scratch using React, including graphs, tables, charts, and consoles. Transferred over 100k lines of code from Angular 8 to React and moved FE services to Kubernetes.

message.name: InLoop LLC (2018-2020)
description: Senior Frontend Developer at Tel Aviv-based startup providing news aggregation solutions. Created new features using React, such as the ability for users to add, save, and comment on articles and events.

Developed an unprecedented new admin panel for company managers to control all generated content and client support on Redux. Provided developer support, including coding standards, code reviews, local dev environments, and CI.
This intelligent environment selects news for clients based on region, topic, and category. Also created a web application using React that can manage CSV files to clean, filter, and manipulate data.

Joined as Frontend Developer (2018), rebuilding the company's core product UI with AngularJS, ASP.NET, and RESTful APIs for better cross-browser compatibility, and building HTML email templates and marketing newsletters within an Agile Scrum process.

message.name: Cultural Service Inc. (2016-2018)
description: Frontend Team Leader (2017-2018) leading a team of six people at Cultural Service Inc., the Moscow-based company behind ponominalu.ru. Developed a progressive web app using Vue.js and React, providing event organizers and distributors with several ways to sell tickets.

Led the team through all phases of development, from architecture design to production deployment. Recommended solutions for a streamlined, user-friendly interface working closely with the design team, improving user experience and conversion rates.

Previously worked as Frontend Developer (2016-2017) on a web app based on Angular, developed an adaptive ticket sales website on Play Framework with Ajax and PostgreSQL, and implemented various API integrations. Started here as Junior Frontend Developer (2016), redesigning existing pages and optimizing frontend performance through CSS and JavaScript minification.

message.name: chitai-gorod.ru — early project (2016)
description: An early-career project from my junior years: chitai-gorod.ru, a service for selling books and audiobooks with a web app for reading and listening to a purchased library.
Developed purchase pages, redesigned shopping carts, and created news display blocks with WordPress, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Picked up CSS preprocessors like LESS and Stylus along the way.
Tested code across multiple browsers and gained foundational experience in cross-browser compatibility and responsive design principles.

message.name: Manuliatina Game (2019)
description: Personal project: interactive visual novel engine with location-based movement system. Developed a complete game engine from scratch with save/load functionality and interactive object system.
The application dynamically loads location data, background music, and navigation paths from MongoDB database. Features include inventory system, character interactions, and branching storylines.
Built with React for smooth user interactions and SCSS for pixel-perfect styling. This project demonstrates full-stack development skills and creative problem-solving in game development.
